messages:
Alex: Quick sync — planning v2.15 rollout next Tue. Need confirmation on region cutoffs and branch freeze windows. Target canaries: US first, then EU, then APAC. @Jordan can you confirm release branch status? Also nudging everyone to add changelog bullets before the cutoff.

Jordan: Branch is cut: `release/v2.15`. There's one flaky integ test around kv-cache eviction, PR #4821 is open. If that merges by EOD we keep the windows. If not we should consider +6h. Pinged reviewers.

Maria: Changelog reminder — I'm consolidating release notes tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Please add a 1-line bullet under the right section (Runtime / Infra / SDK). If you miss the cutoff we'll queue it for a post-release patch.

Lee: SRE note — canary windows look fine, propose 30m warmup before each canary to populate caches. Also please freeze infra config changes from cutoff -> full rollout. Avoid DB migrations during APAC window.

Nora: I'll schedule the 30m warmups and health checks. Adding a short playbook with rollback steps and a link to the canary dashboards.

Jordan: Git commands for the final cut (copy/paste):
```
git checkout -b release/v2.15 origin/main
git merge --no-ff feature/kv-cache-fix
git tag -a v2.15 -m "v2.15 release"
```
No direct commits on `release/*` except hotfixes.

release-bot: Deploy window created: canary-US@2025-11-03T00:00Z, canary-EU@2025-11-03T02:00Z, full-APAC@2025-11-03T09:00Z. Rollout policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 20m increments. Playbook link: /deploys/17795.

Alex: If PR #4821 misses EOD I propose shifting by +6h and nudging APAC to their morning local time next day. Any blockers to that?

Maria: Prefer to avoid >+12h delays unless necessary. Ops needs to confirm on-call coverage for later window.

Lee: SRE can absorb +6h but require strict freeze on infra and no schema changes. We'll run a short chaos-check in canary for ~10m.

Nora: Changelog nudge sent to the team. I'll mark entries as "ready" in the doc and ping again when everything's in.

Jordan: Re-running CI now, hoping to merge tonight. Pinging reviewers @Alex @Nora :eyes:.

Alex: Thanks — I'll publish final cutoff in #announcements once CI/PRs settle. Reminder for release tooling: run `make bump-version VERSION=2.15` and don't edit package metadata after the tag.

ops-bot: Reminder: branch freeze in 12h for release/v2.15. Automated smoke runs scheduled 30m before each canary.

Alex: All right — let's call this the working plan. If anything changes drop a short update here rather than new thread so we keep the audit trail. :ship:
